messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 preproc latency breach detected for /v1/generate (hosted). p95=1.2s p99=5.6s, streaming stall rate 28% over last 5m. Affected region: us-west-2. Pager: @oncall-lina.

oncall-lina: Acked. oncall here, starting triage. tagging eng-sre and eng-runtime. Can someone share a quick p95/p99 time series?

sre-max: grabbing metrics now. p95 jumped from ~300ms to 1.2s ~ 07:23 UTC, p99 spiked to 5-6s. Error rates stable, 502s not increasing. Streaming tail drops around token 512+.

runtime-ashwin: seeing long stalls in the tokenization/preproc stage. CPU of preproc workers spiked to 85-95%. KV cache hit rate unchanged. Suspect prompt-template expansion + JSON-mode path.

ml-zoe: We rolled a prompt-template tweak 07:15 UTC that added tool schema validation in the template renderer (to support better structured tool calls). That touches JSON-mode path for a subset of customers. Could be it.

oncall-lina: ok roll forward hypothesis: template/JSON-mode is causing heavy preproc CPU and long tail. Let's mitigate live: 1) route traffic for affected tier to fallback template (fast path) 2) reduce batching on preproc workers 3) scale preproc workers 4) notify support/customer impact. Who can flip the fast-path?

infra-kyu: I can patch routing for the hosted route to point model-route -> template-fast-v1. Will do a canary 5% first. Running: ```curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/routes/patch -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","template_override":"fast-v1","percent":5}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'```

runtime-ashwin: started reducing max_batch_size for preproc pool to 4 (was 16) via config push to staged nodes: ```kubectl -n inference set env ds/preproc MAX_BATCH=4 --record```

ml-zoe: To be safe I'm reverting the template validation change in the renderer for JSON-mode (hotfix) — toggling env RENDERER_JSON_VALIDATION=false on canary and staging. Command: ```kubectl -n renderer set env deploy/renderer RENDERER_JSON_VALIDATION=false``` Doing canary now on 10% renderer pods.

sre-max: Observability: adding temporary alert to ignore transient >10m blips but keeping page until resolved. Also purging prefix cache for a noisy tenant to see if cache poisoning is part of it: ```redis-cli -h preproc-redis del prefix:tenant:42```

oncall-lina: Good. Any immediate customer impact? product-maria / support-eli?

support-eli: Support queue has 3 tickets flagged high-priority with customers reporting slow responses and partial streams (clients seeing stalls at ~1-2s after start). No widespread 5xx. Logging shows many clients reconnecting.

product-maria: Notifying key customers on the dedicated tier? Might want to proactively message them about degraded latency while we mitigate. Drafting a message: "We're investigating increased latency affecting streaming; mitigation in progress; we'll follow up in 30m."

infra-kyu: Canary route patch applied (5%). Metrics in next 2m.

runtime-ashwin: After lowering batch size on 30% of preproc pods, p99 on those pods dropped to ~1.4s (from 5.6s). Good signal. Continuing rollout to all preproc pods.

ml-zoe: Hotfix env toggle rolled to canary. Renderer logs show fewer expensive schema-parse ops. CPU on renderer canary pods down ~40%.

incident-bot: NOTE: Change detected: route override applied to 5% (admin/infra-kyu).

oncall-lina: rolling mitigation summary for handoff: - cause hypothesis: prompt-template tool-schema validation in JSON-mode causing heavy preproc/render CPU and streaming stalls - mitigation applied: route 5% -> fast-path template, lowered preproc batch size, toggled renderer JSON validation canary, purged noisy prefix cache - initial signal: pods with reduced batch + renderer toggle show p99 improvement from ~5.6s -> ~1.4s.

oncall-lina: I'll continue 30m watch then handoff to @oncall-jamal. Jamal, please pick up monitor and customer comms if I'm offline.

oncall-jamal: Ack, taking handoff. Summary received. I'll keep watch for 2h and escalate to infra if we see error increase.

sre-max: FYI we're seeing residual tail on some customers still using JSON-mode; plan: schedule forced fallback for all hosted traffic in 10m if improvements don't converge.

support-eli: Sent proactive message to 4 customers in affected cohort with an initial incident note. Will update after handoff.

product-maria: Can we capture a short postmortem checklist item: - revert template change to stable version - add load-test for JSON-mode template path - add telemetry for template-render latency per-tenant - gating flag for validation in renderer (off by default)

ml-zoe: Agreed. Also adding experiment to pre-compile tool schemas at model load time to avoid per-request parse. Putting a ticket in backlog now.

oncall-jamal: Monitoring: p99 across region now 1.1-1.5s; streaming stall rate down to 6-8%. Keeping on-call for the next 90m. If stable at 30m mark, I'll remove canary and fully route to fast-path then schedule controlled re-enabling of JSON validation behind feature flag with load-tests.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigations effective. p99 reduced to ~1.3s, streaming stalls now 7%. Page cleared for now.

oncall-jamal: Closing the page. Will open a postmortem doc and assign owners: renderer validation rollback - @ml-zoe, template gating + load tests - @runtime-ashwin, preproc batch autosens - @sre-max, customer comms - @support-eli.

oncall-lina: Thx team. Handoff complete. (reacted :thumbsup:)

support-eli: Leaving notes for customers and attaching timeline.

ml-zoe: Opening follow-up PR to precompile schemas and add telemetry.

runtime-ashwin: Planning config change to make MAX_BATCH adaptive based on 95th latency. Will prototype next sprint.

oncall-jamal: End of thread.
